topic: New analytics report for Malls traffic
summary_markdown: Someone shared a new analytics report focusing on Malls traffic, specifically using the `aka_test_1` dataset for Provanché starting December 1st. The report includes an added column for impressions attributed to 'Vlad' (though two other impression columns were retained as they might be relevant to other clients). A separate request was made regarding adding a large [EXPORT] button near the report options, duplicating the existing cloud icon, but this feature's implementation status is uncertain without further approval.
action_items: Review the new Malls traffic analytics report.
